title: Rethinking Optimal Verification Granularity for Compute-Efficient Test-Time Scaling
authors_zh: Hao Mark Chen、Guanxi Lu、Yasuyuki Okoshi、Zhiwen Mo、Masato Motomura、Hongxiang Fan
paper_type_zh: Rollout、搜索或测试时轨迹研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计推理轨迹、反馈契约、选择机制与复现边界的读者
one_line: VG-Search controls verifier cadence to trade prefix pruning against inference cost.
VG-Search 通过控制验证器的调用频率，在前缀剪枝收益与推理开销之间做权衡。（论文未披露的发布、回放与审计细节保留为未知。）
why: Verification frequency itself is a trace/compute allocation policy.
inclusion_reason: Controls when prefix trace observations influence search.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Verifier-guided test-time search usually chooses one fixed intervention scale: score every reasoning step as in beam search, or wait until complete answers as in Best-of-N. Frequent checks can prune errors early but repeatedly run an expensive process reward model; sparse checks reduce verifier cost and permit broader exploration but can let bad prefixes grow. The paper asks how verification frequency should depend on generator strength, verifier strength, task difficulty, and compute budget.

The evidence object is a search trajectory, not a released prompt-to-trace corpus: a math problem, newline-delimited reasoning steps, candidate prefixes of g steps, scalar PRM scores, beam/branch decisions, rejected paths, generation and verification compute, and the selected final solution. MATH-250 is used to choose policies and MATH-500/AIME to evaluate them; these benchmark records do not themselves constitute a reusable VG-Search trajectory release.

Verifier 引导的测试时搜索通常固定在一种介入尺度：像 beam search 一样逐步评分，或像 Best-of-N 一样等完整答案生成后再评分。频繁检查能较早剪除错误，但会反复调用昂贵的过程奖励模型；稀疏检查可减少 verifier 成本并扩大探索，却可能让错误前缀继续增长。论文研究验证频率应如何随 generator 强度、verifier 强度、任务难度和计算预算变化。

这里的证据对象是一类搜索轨迹，而不是已发布的 prompt-to-trace 语料：数学题、以换行分隔的推理步骤、每 g 步形成的候选前缀、标量 PRM 分数、beam/branch 决策、被拒路径、生成与验证计算量及最终选中解答。MATH-250 用于选择策略，MATH-500/AIME 用于评测；这些 benchmark 记录本身不构成可复用的 VG-Search 轨迹发布。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Variable Granularity Search (VG-Search) introduces a granularity parameter g: the proposer generates g reasoning steps before the verifier scores each partial or complete candidate. With beam width B1 and branch factor B2, every cycle scores B1 × B2 candidates, retains B1, extends them, and repeats. g = 1 approaches verifier-guided beam search; a very large g approaches Best-of-N.

The paper adds two validation-tuned policies. CM-g selects the largest g that stays within an accuracy tolerance of g = 1, targeting lower compute. AM-g selects the g with maximum validation accuracy under a budget. The chosen g can vary by model, task difficulty group, and number of generations, but remains fixed within a single problem trajectory; it is not step-by-step adaptive verification.

Variable Granularity Search（VG-Search）引入粒度参数 g：proposer 每生成 g 个推理步骤，verifier 才对各个部分或完整候选评分。给定 beam width B1 与 branch factor B2，每个循环对 B1 × B2 个候选评分，保留 B1 个，再扩展并重复。g = 1 接近 verifier 引导的 beam search；很大的 g 则接近 Best-of-N。

论文进一步提出两种用验证集调节的策略。CM-g 选择仍能把准确率保持在 g = 1 容差范围内的最大 g，以降低计算；AM-g 在预算约束下选择验证准确率最高的 g。所选 g 可以随模型、任务难度组和生成数量改变，但在单个问题轨迹内保持固定，并不是逐步自适应验证。

title: Method
方法
html:
The experiments use MATH-500, 90 AIME problems from 2022–2024, and MATH-250, a validation sample with 50 problems at each MATH difficulty level. Proposers are Qwen2.5-Math-7B, Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B, and Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct. Skywork-o1-Open-PRM-Qwen-2.5-1.5B and 7B serve as discriminative verifiers. A double newline defines the smallest reasoning step, and selection uses the PRM’s final score.

The study varies g, generation count n, beam width, branch factor, model pairing, difficulty, and budget. Its analytical cost model separates proposer compute for extending and branching from verifier compute for scoring candidates. CM-g and AM-g estimate a policy on validation data, then reuse that precomputed g for a model/task/budget configuration; the paper recommends recomputation when a core component changes.

A reusable record should preserve prompt and benchmark identity; proposer, verifier, prompt template, and revisions; step delimiter; g, B1, B2, n, and budget; all candidate prefixes and parent links; PRM scores; selected and rejected branches; generation/verification FLOPs and latency; validation policy and difficulty bucket; random seed; final answer; and ground-truth correctness. The official VG-Search repository exposes code and recipes under Apache-2.0, but the accepted metadata does not verify a standalone trace corpus, exact run manifest, or licenses for all models and source benchmarks.

实验使用 MATH-500、2022–2024 年的 90 道 AIME 题，以及 MATH-250；后者是验证集，每个 MATH 难度等级抽取 50 题。Proposer 包括 Qwen2.5-Math-7B、Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B 和 Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct；Skywork-o1-Open-PRM-Qwen-2.5-1.5B 与 7B 作为判别式 verifier。连续两个换行定义最小推理步骤，选择时使用 PRM 的最终分数。

研究改变 g、生成数量 n、beam width、branch factor、模型配对、难度和预算。其分析成本模型把用于扩展与分支的 proposer 计算同候选评分的 verifier 计算分开。CM-g 与 AM-g 在验证数据上估计策略，然后为特定 model/task/budget 配置复用预先计算的 g；论文建议在核心组件变化时重新计算。

可复用记录应保留 prompt 与 benchmark 标识、proposer/verifier/提示模板及版本、步骤分隔符、g/B1/B2/n/预算、全部候选前缀与父节点、PRM 分数、被选与被拒分支、生成/验证 FLOPs 与延迟、验证集策略与难度桶、随机种子、最终答案和标准正确性。官方 VG-Search 仓库以 Apache-2.0 提供代码与 recipe，但已接受元数据未核实独立轨迹语料、精确运行清单，或所有模型与源 benchmark 的许可。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Profiling shows that more than half of two-step PRM score changes are below 1% of the score range in one reported setting, motivating the claim that some adjacent checks are redundant. Across model pairs, the best g changes with generator capability and budget: with Qwen2.5-Math-7B plus Skywork-o1-1.5B, g = 3 reaches about four percentage points higher peak MATH-500 accuracy than g = 1 at medium-to-high compute, while the weaker non-math Llama generator benefits from denser verification.

On MATH-500 with Qwen2.5-Math-7B and Skywork-o1-1.5B, the validation-tuned adaptive methods report gains of up to 3.1 points over Beam Search and 3.6 over Best-of-N, with compute reductions above 52%. At n = 128, validation-tuned CM-g reports 89.9% accuracy using 11,086 modeled FLOPs versus 24,021 for the beam-search baseline. A three-seed appendix checks stability for one model pair.

These are comparisons of search policies under a paper-specific FLOPs proxy, step delimiter, PRM, and benchmark. They do not verify that every PRM score is calibrated, every retained prefix is correct, or every rejected branch is low quality; benchmark accuracy is not record-level trace-quality evidence.

性能分析显示，在一个报告设置中，超过一半的两步 PRM 分数变化小于分数范围的 1%，由此支持部分相邻检查存在冗余的动机。不同模型配对的最佳 g 会随 generator 能力和预算变化：Qwen2.5-Math-7B 搭配 Skywork-o1-1.5B 时，g = 3 在中高计算量下的 MATH-500 峰值准确率比 g = 1 高约 4 个百分点；较弱且未做数学微调的 Llama generator 则更需要密集验证。

在 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 与 Skywork-o1-1.5B 的 MATH-500 设置中，用验证集调节的自适应方法相对 Beam Search 最高提升 3.1 个点、相对 Best-of-N 最高提升 3.6 个点，并报告超过 52% 的计算削减。n = 128 时，validation-tuned CM-g 报告 89.9% 准确率和 11,086 模型化 FLOPs，而 beam-search 基线为 24,021。附录还对一个模型配对进行了三随机种子稳定性检查。

这些结果是在论文特定 FLOPs 代理、步骤分隔符、PRM 和 benchmark 下对搜索策略的比较。它们不能证明每个 PRM 分数都已校准、每个保留前缀都正确，或每个被拒分支都低质量；benchmark 准确率不是记录级轨迹质量证据。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
VG-Search’s main contribution is to elevate verification cadence from an implicit implementation choice to an explicit search variable with accuracy and compute consequences. The same scaffold spans the endpoints of step-wise beam search and answer-level Best-of-N, enabling controlled comparisons without changing the basic proposer–verifier contract. CM-g and AM-g then turn those measurements into reusable per-configuration cadence policies.

The work does not introduce PRMs, beam search, Best-of-N, or a new labeled reasoning dataset. It also does not adapt g inside an individual solution. For this track, the direction signal is the trace schema: verifier call timing, skipped checks, branch pruning, and compute allocation must be logged alongside scores if search trajectories are to be audited or reused.

VG-Search 的主要贡献，是把验证节奏从隐含实现选择提升为一个会影响准确率与计算量的显式搜索变量。同一 scaffold 覆盖逐步 beam search 和答案级 Best-of-N 两个端点，因而能在不改变基本 proposer–verifier 契约的前提下做受控比较。CM-g 与 AM-g 再把这些测量转为可复用的配置级节奏策略。

该工作没有提出 PRM、beam search、Best-of-N，也没有发布新的带标签推理数据集；它也不会在单条解答内部调整 g。对本 track 而言，方向信号在于轨迹 schema：若要审计或复用搜索轨迹，就必须把 verifier 调用时点、跳过的检查、分支剪枝和计算分配与分数一起记录。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The smallest “step” is defined by a double newline, so g depends on prompt style and model formatting rather than a semantic unit guaranteed across generators. A PRM score is only an estimate of prefix quality; noise or miscalibration can make frequent pruning remove recoverable paths, while sparse verification can extend errors. The optimal g changes with model pair, difficulty, and budget, limiting transfer of a precomputed policy.

Despite the term adaptive, g is fixed throughout each problem. CM-g and AM-g use validation accuracy, so small validation subsets or difficulty labels can overfit the policy; oracle-tuned values use test data and are not deployable. Experiments are math-focused, and modeled FLOPs do not capture every systems cost or latency effect.

The code release is not a verified data release. Raw trees, rejected prefixes, verifier-score logs, exact prompts, environment snapshots, complete seeds, and a trace-level manifest remain unverified; decontamination and source/model license compatibility are also unresolved. Reported benchmark and compute gains evaluate a selector, not the intrinsic correctness or completeness of stored process records.

最小“步骤”由连续两个换行定义，因此 g 依赖提示风格与模型格式，而不是跨 generator 都成立的语义单元。PRM 分数只是前缀质量估计；噪声或失校准会使频繁剪枝删除仍可修复的路径，稀疏验证又可能继续扩展错误。最佳 g 随模型配对、难度和预算变化，因此预计算策略的迁移能力有限。

尽管名称中使用 adaptive，g 在每个问题内部保持固定。CM-g 与 AM-g 依赖验证集准确率，小验证子集或难度标签可能导致策略过拟合；oracle-tuned 值使用测试数据，不能部署。实验集中于数学，模型化 FLOPs 也不能覆盖全部系统成本与延迟影响。

代码发布不等于数据发布。原始搜索树、被拒前缀、verifier 分数日志、精确提示、环境快照、完整随机种子和轨迹级清单均未核实；去污染流程及源数据/模型许可兼容性也未解决。报告的 benchmark 与计算收益是在评估 selector，而不是证明所存过程记录本身正确或完整。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the rollout/search/test-time-trace track, VG-Search supplies a clean vocabulary for representing when verification intervenes and how that decision changes the explored tree. It is useful for building comparable search logs, profiling proposer versus verifier cost, evaluating pruning policies, and auditing whether a claimed efficiency gain comes from fewer verifier calls, narrower exploration, or better selection.

A downstream dataset could use these records for policy analysis or to learn cadence decisions, but that would be a new use requiring explicit trace release and labels. The paper directly supports test-time compute and evaluation, not an existing SFT, reward-modeling, or RL corpus. Reuse should keep PRM score, selection decision, final-answer correctness, and measured compute separate.

对 rollout/search/test-time-trace 方向，VG-Search 提供了表示“验证何时介入、该决策如何改变搜索树”的清晰词汇。它适合构建可比较的搜索日志、分析 proposer 与 verifier 成本、评估剪枝策略，并审计效率提升究竟来自更少 verifier 调用、更窄探索，还是更好的选择。

下游数据集可以利用这些记录分析策略或学习节奏决策，但那属于需要显式轨迹发布与标签的新用途。论文直接支持测试时计算和评测，而不是现成的 SFT、reward modeling 或 RL 语料。复用时应把 PRM 分数、选择决策、最终答案正确性和实测计算量分开保存。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Treat g as the number of newline-delimited reasoning steps between verifier calls, not a universal semantic unit.
  • Preserve every B1 × B2 candidate, PRM score, retained beam, rejected branch, and compute measurement.
  • Separate validation-tuned CM-g/AM-g from oracle choices made with MATH-500 test performance.
  • Recompute cadence when the proposer, verifier, task distribution, difficulty bucket, or budget changes.
  • Treat accuracy/FLOPs gains as search-policy evidence, not proof of trace-record quality.

• 将 g 理解为两次 verifier 调用之间由换行分隔的推理步骤数，而非通用语义单元。
  • 保留每个 B1 × B2 候选、PRM 分数、被保留 beam、被拒分支和计算量测量。
  • 区分用验证集调节的 CM-g/AM-g 与利用 MATH-500 测试表现选择的 oracle。
  • 当 proposer、verifier、任务分布、难度桶或预算变化时重新计算验证节奏。
  • 把准确率/FLOPs 提升视为搜索策略证据，而非轨迹记录质量证明。
